title: The Internal badge shows on the customers list mobile card
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a phone, or a browser window narrowed to 390 pixels wide, signed in to the same account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Customers list.
  2. Search for customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customers list shows as cards.

Step 2:

  • Customer A's card shows the "Internal" badge next to its name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R8: “While the setting is on, a flagged customer shows an "Internal" badge next to its name in the customer header, in the customers list and on the customers list mobile card. While the setting is off the badge is hidden in all three places (S1-N4); the badges on work orders stay (S2-R10).”
  • Story 1, Form factor: “Form factor: Desktop only by rule. This surface is a settings toggle and the customer dialog; mobile is not applicable. The Internal badge on the customers list mobile card (S1-R8) is the one mobile touch.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
